justification: Both surfaces depict anthropomorphic beings with visible arms/hands and emphasised heads, but A shows massed, rounded, low-relief figures with large hollow eye sockets crowded together in an amorphous field, while B shows a single frontal standing figure in fine linear outline with a tall plumed headdress, beaded belt, pendant apron and held staff-like objects. The specific attributes, costume detail, posture and compositional logic share nothing beyond the universal fact of a human-like form, and the depiction conventions (massive rounded volumes vs. thin contour drawing with dotted bead rows) are entirely different.
